lead.description: the practice of presenting a hypothesis suggested by the results as if it had been stated in advance

self_checks.title: Expected false alarms
self_checks.prompt: Twenty independent tests of true nulls are each run at level 0.05. What is the expected number of results with p < 0.05?

self_checks.title: A stricter level
self_checks.prompt: The same twenty true nulls are tested at level 0.01. What is the expected number with p < 0.01?

kerr1998.title: HARKing: Hypothesizing After the Results Are Known

ioannidis2005.title: Why Most Published Research Findings Are False

overview_sentence: HARKing presents a hypothesis suggested by the results as if it had been stated before the data were seen.
